unresolved.finding: Pointing and many s102 differences still require native-crop adjudication.
Remaining Erev pages not yet compared.
s102 fine pointing including בריכם, סוגג, נכאה/דכאות and נטעינו remains provisional; native crops reject fresh רפא־אות and בולענים.
s110 fine pointing at באלמך/אכסניון/שבעה/כלוחך/ערבתם.
s112–s118 comparison differences pending native-crop adjudication.
s112 fine points including דלותי, חיות/מה־שיחהו, החָרות and מעֲלי־בך remain provisional.
s114 fine points at אבידל/כרצוניו/זמניו remain provisional; native crops settle visible consonants.
s114 אבדל: retain original consonants; possible narrow stroke not settled, no plene yod supplied.
s116 first Adon line: native looks תנורת רחם, existing חנה רחם not settled; retained pending further review. Also fine points at ויעדו, היצדק/הטהר.
s118 first concluding stanza זכם/יכס קרבנתך and זרו/יחמו, fine points in פחנו/מנול retained or provisional. No automatic substitution from familiar wording.
s120 fine pointing in בצול, לקנויך, בהתגולל and כתקח remains provisional.
s122–128 comparison not yet adjudicated.
s122 fine points at קריבות תריץ, שִיה לכף, לבת חקיך remain provisional.
s124 fine pointing at יסְטיא/מנון/הפונקש and obscure מהגו/רעלהו/כרם still require independent review.
s126–128 fine pointing still requires independent review; native מפהה is unusual and retained as printed. s128 משהנברינו-like first word, ידעתו and final והנשה require independent confirmation.
s130 fine marks remain provisional, especially somber words at מהלכו/סמכתהו; native retains old ותושב/קראני/על־יובל/מכל־אשר, rejecting fresh misreadings. s128 עלמי defective spelling restored.
s132 pointing requires independent confirmation; native unusual ולא ינזק retained rather than normalized to familiar יזיק. Boundary after והגושם precedes Esther quotation.
s134 fine pointing provisional, particularly מיוסד/רגלי־בני and אספת. Native יַעַבדוך differs from old ישתחוו and is retained. Hebrew poem extends to s136.
s136 fine pointing remains provisional; native rare הכר/אודם/איש ולויות/להוות retained. Next s138 starts later verse/poem; not yet read.
s138 fine points provisional, especially obscure דפנוי־עון בתהון and מפשעך; printed phrase retained without normalization. Repetition brackets and congregation cue preserved.
s140 remaining fine points require independent review. Ark-opening rubric is retained as a performance instruction; only fulfilled say-prayer clauses disappear in expanded view.
s142 fine pointing provisional. Preserve Ark closure and final שופט וכו cue separately from fulfilled repeat instruction. Refrain expansion must follow corrected source wording.
